comparison.objective: Hang two assigned keys in a cabinet, seat their blades in guides, and close the door; candidate performs screening.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-ring hook insertion, keyed placement, and door manipulation versus bimanual pouring and granular bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Both keys stably hung in assigned positions and door closed versus ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, and screen released.
comparison.reason: Fine hook placement is a different tested ability from bulk size/orientation separation.
